An [[ST-70 assault ship]] also known as the '''''Razor Crest''''' was used by the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] and served as a brand-new<ref name="New">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-mandalorian-and-grogu-trailer-key-art-1|text=''The Mandalorian and Grogu'' First Teaser Trailer Revealed}}</ref> replacement to his [[Din Djarin's N-1 starfighter|N-1 starfighter]] and his original starship the ''[[Razor Crest]]''.<ref name="TeaserTrailer"/>
